settings.groupIdHelp: Paste the Telegram group or supergroup chat ID — it is usually a negative number starting with -100. To get it: add the bot to the group, send any message in the group, then copy the group chat ID. This single interactive group receives notifications and hosts the group chatbot.
settings.telegramUserAccessHelp: Select staff, then paste each person's private Telegram Chat User ID now — no need to wait for /link. Turn on Chatbot for private bot access (password resets are delivered there), and turn on Group to let them use the chatbot in the Group ID above. A Chat ID typed here is kept; it also auto-fills after the staff member links Telegram with /link CODE.
settings.telegramUserAccessChatbotHelp: Chatbot: this staff member can talk to the bot in a private chat using their Chat User ID. Password reset codes are delivered here only — never to the group.
settings.telegramUserAccessGroupHelp: Group: this staff member may use the chatbot inside the interactive Group ID configured above.
settings.telegramUserAccessEmpty: No staff configured. Sync all users or add a row — you can type each Chat User ID now, and it also auto-fills after they link Telegram with /link CODE.
